2026-11-06.headline: SAF maps Zero Trust frameworks to disciplines, roles, capabilities, and implementation
2026-11-06.overview: The period centered on a substantive expansion and reorganization of Microsoft’s Security Adoption Framework guidance. New mapping guidance covers Zero Trust, the CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model, and the DoD Zero Trust Strategy, while related SAF material adds connections among business priorities, risk, responsibilities, implementation, and measurement. Two lower-impact updates refreshed titles and publication dates for MCRA and the SecOps workshop.
2026-11-06.adminImpact: Security architects and administrators can use the new framework mappings and role- or objective-based navigation to plan security improvements, coordinate stakeholders, assess alignment, and direct teams to relevant guidance. No configuration, migration, or other operational change is specified; the MCRA and SecOps updates primarily improve identification of current guidance.

keyChanges.title: New standards-to-SAF mappings
keyChanges.detail: The new guidance maps security standards and framework objectives to SAF disciplines, roles, Microsoft security capabilities, and implementation guidance, including mappings for Zero Trust, the CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model, and the DoD Zero Trust Strategy.

keyChanges.title: SAF now links strategy through measurement
keyChanges.detail: The SAF page now connects business priorities, risk, Zero Trust principles, security disciplines, technologies, and technical solutions, and adds guidance on shared responsibilities, implementation, measurement, and four connected framework components across hybrid, multicloud, and multiplatform environments.

keyChanges.title: SAF navigation shifts to goals and roles
keyChanges.detail: “Using SAF effectively” now directs readers through tables organized around objectives and organizational roles, linking to strategy, architecture, disciplines, scenarios, technologies, workshops, and related guidance instead of the former top-down, build-up, and scenario-driven patterns.

keyChanges.title: MCRA title and publication date refreshed
keyChanges.detail: The MCRA page and heading now omit “Review,” and its publication date is shown as November 6, 2026, replacing November 2.

keyChanges.title: SecOps workshop naming and date updated
keyChanges.detail: The Microsoft Zero Trust Workshop page now uses “SecOps” capitalization in its title and heading, and its page date changed from May 24 to November 6, 2026.

2026-11-08.headline: SAF maps established security guidance into integrated, aligned, and companion resources
2026-11-08.overview: A new Security Adoption Framework (SAF) article explains how existing Microsoft security guidance relates to SAF. It groups resources as integrated, SAF-aligned, or companion guidance and maps them to SAF disciplines.
2026-11-08.adminImpact: Administrators can use the mappings to locate relevant planning, architecture, implementation, and operations guidance. No administrative action is specified.

keyChanges.title: SAF guidance mapping
